sections.text:
There were two cousins, the first lived in a quiet and simple rural village (the Country Mouse), and the second lived in a huge mansion in a noisy and bustling city (the City Mouse).

One day, the city mouse decided to visit his cousin in the countryside to see how he lived.

The country mouse received his cousin very warmly in his little burrow full of dry straw, and honored him with hospitality and gave him all the food he had.

But country food was very simple; Some durum wheat kernels, dry bread scraps, a few wild plant roots, and pure water from a spring.

The city mouse looked at the food with disgust and refused to eat it, and said arrogantly to his cousin: “How can you live on this bad food and this miserable, depressing life? The burrow is small, the food is tough, and there is no entertainment here!”

Then he added excitedly: “You should come with me to the city, my cousin! I will show you what real life is like. I will feed you fine cheeses, meats, and sweets, and you will live like royalty in a spacious and beautiful palace!”

The simple country mouse was impressed by this fantastic description, and immediately agreed to go with him.

They traveled together and arrived at night at the huge city palace, where the city mouse took his country cousin straight to the royal dining room.

At the dining table, the country mouse found things he had never dreamed of; Leftover feasts of grilled cold meats, huge chunks of fine French cheese, soft butter, sugar cookies, and colorful fresh fruit!
The two mice began to devour this imaginary meal greedily and with great happiness, and the countryside mouse said with his mouth full of food: “You are right, my cousin! This is real life. I have been wasting my life in the miserable countryside!”

However, as soon as he had finished his sentence, he heard the barking of two huge and very ferocious dogs (the palace's guard dogs) approaching the room quickly!
The blood in the veins of the country mouse froze with terror, and the city mouse screamed: “Run quickly, or they will devour us!”

The two mice ran as quickly as they could towards a small hole in the wall of the palace to hide in. The dogs' fangs almost grabbed the tail of the countryside mouse, which was trembling in fear, and its heart was beating so hard that it almost exploded its chest.

After a while, things calmed down and the dogs left, so the two mice went out cautiously to finish their food.

As soon as they started eating again, the door to the room suddenly opened, and the palace maid entered carrying a huge broom, and began sweeping the floor and hitting the broom everywhere!
She was accompanied by a very large cat with sharp claws and bright yellow eyes. The cat pounced on the mice as soon as she saw them!
The two mice escaped again with great difficulty into the burrow, panting and feeling their death approaching at every moment.

When they were safely inside the dark hole, the country mouse wiped the sweat from his brow, dusted himself off, and said to his cousin with a decisive decision: “Thank you, cousin, for this luxurious feast, but I will return immediately to my simple village now!”

The city mouse said in surprise: “Come back? Now? Why? Didn’t you like the fine food and the great palace?”

The country mouse answered with wisdom and certainty: “The food is wonderful and the palace is amazing, but I would rather eat a piece of dry bread and a hard grain of wheat and feel complete peace and security in my simple countryside, than eat fine cheese and meat while trembling in fear and feeling the danger of death every second in your noisy city! Safety and security are better than treasures and luxury with fear.”

The country mouse returned to his hole, and never thought about the city again.
